title: Gopi Chand Sees Bigger Horizons for Current Indian Players
indian_angle: Legendary Indian coach Pullela Gopi Chand shares his perspective on the bright future and expanded opportunities for the current generation of Indian badminton players.
summary: Pullella Gopi Chand, a prominent figure in Indian badminton, expressed his belief that today's players have significantly broader opportunities and horizons compared to previous generations.

title: India Employs 'Monkey Whisperers' for BWF World Championships Security
indian_angle: India, as the host nation for the BWF World Championships, is taking unique measures to ensure a smooth event, including addressing local wildlife challenges.
summary: To protect the venue of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi from macaques, India is employing 'monkey whisperers' who will mimic langur calls, a unique security measure costing ₹20 crore.

title: Ayush Shetty Ready for World No.1 Shi Yu Qi Challenge at Worlds
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty is set to face a formidable challenge against world No.1 Shi Yu Qi in the first round of the BWF World Championships.
summary: Fresh off an Asia silver medal, 21-year-old Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty is preparing to face Chinese world No.1 Shi Yu Qi in the opening round of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, showing no fear despite the tough draw.

title: PV Sindhu Reacts to 'Monkey Whisperers' at BWF Worlds Venue
indian_angle: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu shares her lighthearted reaction to the unusual security measures being implemented for the BWF World Championships in Delhi.
summary: Indian badminton ace PV Sindhu commented on the organizers' plan to use men mimicking langur calls to deter macaques at the BWF World Championships venue in Delhi, finding humor in the unique solution.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This highlights the preparation of India's promising young talent for significant continental junior championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Players Qualified for World Junior Championships 2026 Final Trials
indian_angle: Indian junior players are undergoing final selection trials to represent the nation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the list of eligible players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.
